item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 05/Jun/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong today. Meanwhile, an upper-air disturbance will bring showers to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening, the weather will improve gradually over Guangdong in the next couple of days, and it will be very hot during the day over the weekend to early next week. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the central part of the South China Sea to the vicinity of Luzon early to midweek next week. There may be an associated area of low pressure developing gradually over the South China Sea or the seas east of the Philippines, but there are uncertainties in its movement and its speed of development.
